==Description==
The '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' is an official Roblox toy that was released on the 22nd of July 2020. The toy offers the [[Turret]] (Default Level 5) and [[Soldier]] (Default Level 3, without the backpack). 

Anybody that buys the toy is given a code, which, when redeemed, gives the Portable Sentry accessory. You can also buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' with two mystery figures from Series 8 of the Roblox Toy line for the same code. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:You can never have enough friends or firepower if you hope to survive the zombie apocalypse in Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator. Set up a sentry along the perimeter to soften the horde's defenses, then knock out the stragglers with your rifleman. With the right strategy in place, you might just be able to survive another wave.
*:Experience an all-new adventure with a legendary character from the world of Roblox - Mix and match parts to build your own unique Roblox character - Deck out your figures with the included accessories - Each package comes with a redeemable code to unlock an exclusive virtual item on Roblox - Collect all your favorite Roblox figures today!
*'''On Pack'''
*:You can never be too prepared for the zombie apocalypse. Turn up the heat with this soldier from Paradoxum Games' Towers Defense Simulator.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $13-$32.34 in the US, CA$18-$25 in Canada, £7 in the UK and €8.50 in the EU. There may be additional costs if you buy this pack with two mystery figures.

The stores in which you can buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' depends on country. The toy is subject to availability.

==Trivia==
*This was the first Tower Defense Simulator-themed Roblox toy to be released.
*The reason why all towers had a skin tone change in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] was due to the fact that Roblox cannot sell humanoids with yellow skin due to copyright reasons with LEGO.
**Therefore, all the towers in Tower Defense Simulator changed their skin tone from yellow.
**However the {{Color|Premium|XR500}} skin for the [[Turret]] still has a yellow skin tone.
***This is likely an oversight rather than being done on purpose.
*The [[Soldier]] that comes with the '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' is similar in appearance to the original Level 3 Default [[Soldier]], just without the laser on the SCAR-H.
**The [[Turret]] that comes with the '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' is similar in appearance to the Level 5 Default [[Turret]].
*The [[Sentry]] features in the {{RLinkC|4645927667|Portable Sentry}} accessory, which comes from the '''Roblox Action Collection - Tower Defense Simulator''', despite its removal from the game.
*The online description of the Roblox toy improperly calls the [[Soldier]] a ''Rifleman'' and the [[Turret]] a ''Sentry''.
